cases.explain: The word is the subject of the short-form predicates «пахуч и странен», and a subject stands in the nominative.

cases.sentence: В нем нет ни капли ___, но есть букет.
cases.explain: «Нет» expressing absence puts the missing thing in the genitive, and the measure phrase «ни капли» reinforces it.

cases.sentence: Он ведет меня от страданий – к ___.
cases.explain: The preposition «к» meaning 'towards' always governs the dative: к свету.
«Взглянуть на» takes the accusative; because безбожник is animate masculine, its accusative copies the genitive form.

cases.sentence: Смешать водку с ___ – в этом есть известный каприз.
cases.explain: «С» in the sense of 'together with' requires the instrumental: с одеколоном.

cases.sentence: Почему-то никто в ___ не знает, отчего умер Пушкин.
cases.explain: «В» answering «где?» (location, not direction) takes the prepositional case: в России.

cases.sentence: Это лучшее средство от ___ и поверхностного атеизма.
cases.explain: The preposition «от» meaning 'against / away from' governs the genitive: средство от самомнения.
The instrument or means of an action stands in the instrumental case with no preposition: помешивать жимолостью.

reading.question: What advice does Venichka give at the very start of the chapter?
options: Drink more and eat less with it
Drink only once you reach Petushki
reading.correct: Drink more and eat less with it
reading.explain: He opens by recommending more drink and less food, calling it the best remedy for conceit.

reading.ru: Это лучшее средство от самомнения и поверхностного атеизма.
reading.question: What does Venichka say that advice is the best remedy against?
reading.explain: He presents drinking more and eating less as a cure for self-importance and superficial unbelief.

reading.ru: Отвернитесь от него, сплюньте и взгляните на меня, когда я стану икать.
reading.question: What does Venichka tell the reader to do about the hiccuping unbeliever?
options: Turn away from him, spit, and look at Venichka instead
reading.correct: Turn away from him, spit, and look at Venichka instead
reading.explain: He contrasts the wretched hiccuping atheist with himself, who is good and full of light because he believes.

reading.ru: Он ведет меня от страданий – к свету.
reading.question: Where does Venichka say He is leading him?
options: From the shop to the station
reading.explain: He glosses this journey as going from Moscow to Petushki and sums it up in German: through suffering — light.

reading.ru: Что мне выпить во Имя Твое?..
reading.question: What question strikes Venichka like lightning as he paces the carriage platform?
options: What he could drink in God's name
Where he has left his little suitcase
How much money he has left
reading.correct: What he could drink in God's name
reading.explain: Smoking in agitation, he suddenly wonders what drink would be worthy of being drunk in God's name.

reading.question: How does Venichka rate the ordinary vodkas he could offer?
options: He dismisses them as unworthy — Kubanskaya is filth
He calls Kubanskaya the finest of them all
He says they are all equally sacred
He says he cannot afford any of them
reading.correct: He dismisses them as unworthy — Kubanskaya is filth
reading.explain: He complains that he has nothing worthy of God: not Kubanskaya, not Rossiyskaya, not the pink fortified wine at a rouble thirty-seven.

reading.ru: Я назову его «Иорданские струи» или «Звезда Вифлеема».
reading.question: What does Venichka plan to name the cocktail he will invent if he reaches Petushki unharmed?
options: Jordan Streams or Star of Bethlehem
reading.correct: Jordan Streams or Star of Bethlehem
reading.explain: He wants a drink that could be taken without shame in the presence of God and of people, and asks to be reminded of the plan.

reading.ru: Мы не можем ждать милостей от природы.
reading.question: What does Venichka say just before he starts giving out his recipes?
options: That we cannot wait for favours from nature
That nature always provides for the drinker
That the recipes are a state secret
That every cocktail must be drunk alone
reading.correct: That we cannot wait for favours from nature
reading.explain: He parodies the famous slogan: since we cannot wait for nature's favours, we need to know the exact recipes for taking them.

reading.question: Which component of Canaan Balsam does Venichka prize above all?
reading.explain: He values it for its bare taste sensation and above all for the miasma it gives off.

reading.question: What does Venichka claim absolutely everyone in Russia knows?
options: The recipe for Komsomol Girl's Tear
The way to the Kursk station
reading.explain: He jokes that nobody knows what Pushkin died of, yet every last person knows how to purify polish.

reading.question: What does Venichka call the lasting smell of Canaan Balsam?
options: The scent of a Moscow morning
reading.explain: He says it is not an aroma but a hymn, because vulgarity and dark forces ripen in whoever drinks the cocktail.

reading.question: What did Venichka do after weeping over his mother on a whole bottle of Silvery Lily of the Valley?
options: He drank a bottle of White Lilac
He wrote his mother a letter
reading.correct: He drank a bottle of White Lilac
reading.explain: White Lilac calms the conscience: his tears dried, silly laughter took over, and he even forgot his mother's name and patronymic.

reading.question: What is Venichka's verdict on stirring Komsomol Girl's Tear with dodder instead of honeysuckle?
options: It is acceptable in an emergency
It is the only correct method
reading.explain: He says he would sooner be cut to pieces than stir the drink with dodder, and he laughs himself to bits when others do it.

reading.ru: Это уже не напиток – это музыка сфер.
reading.question: How does Venichka describe his last and best cocktail, «Сучий потрох»?
options: No longer a drink but the music of the spheres
reading.correct: No longer a drink but the music of the spheres
reading.explain: He offers it as the crown of his labours, a drink that eclipses everything else.

reading.ru: Пейте его с появлением первой звезды, большими глотками.
reading.question: How does Venichka say «Сучий потрох» should be drunk?
options: At the appearance of the first star, in big gulps
Slowly through a straw at dawn
Only after it has been poured through a colander
Warm, together with the morning beer
reading.correct: At the appearance of the first star, in big gulps
reading.explain: After two glasses of it a man becomes so spiritual that you can spit in his face for half an hour and he will say nothing.

highlight.question: Which sentence tells the reader what to do about the hiccuping unbeliever?
sentences: Да.
Больше пейте, меньше закусывайте.
Это лучшее средство от самомнения и поверхностного атеизма.
Взгляните на икающего безбожника: он рассредоточен и темнолик, он мучается и он безобразен.
Отвернитесь от него, сплюньте и взгляните на меня, когда я стану икать.
Верящий в предопределение и ни о каком противоборстве не помышляющий, я верю в то, что Он благ, и сам я поэтому благ и светел.
highlight.explain: Only this sentence gives instructions about the unbeliever — turn away, spit, and look at Venichka instead.

highlight.question: Which sentence lists the stations of the journey — the torments, the purification and the reveries?
sentences: Он благ.
Он ведет меня от страданий – к свету.
От Москвы – к Петушкам.
Через муки на Курском вокзале, через очищение в Кучине, через грезы в Купавне – к свету и Петушкам.
Durch Leiden – Licht!
highlight.explain: The fourth sentence names the three stages and the places where they happen.

highlight.question: Which sentence states that Venichka owns nothing worthy of God?
sentences: Беда!
Нет у меня ничего такого, что было бы Тебя достойно.
Кубанская – это такое дерьмо!
А российская – смешно при Тебе и говорить о российской.
И розовое крепкое за рупь тридцать семь!
Боже!..
highlight.explain: The second sentence makes the general claim; the ones after it merely list the unworthy drinks.

highlight.question: Which sentence says that a drink has a certain caprice about it but no pathos?
sentences: Пить просто водку, даже из горлышка, – в этом нет ничего, кроме томления духа и суеты.
Смешать водку с одеколоном – в этом есть известный каприз, но нет никакого пафоса.
А вот выпить стакан «Ханаанского бальзама» – в этом есть и каприз, и идея, и пафос, и сверх того еще метафизический намек.
highlight.explain: Mixing vodka with eau de cologne is the case that has caprice but lacks pathos.

highlight.question: Which sentence contrasts what Russians do not know about Pushkin with what they all do know?
sentences: Не буду вам напоминать, как очищается политура.
Это всякий младенец знает.
Почему-то никто в России не знает, отчего умер Пушкин, а как очищается политура – это всякий знает.
highlight.explain: The last sentence sets the unknown cause of Pushkin's death against the universally known method of purifying polish.

highlight.question: Which sentence explains why the smell of Canaan Balsam deserves to be called a hymn?
sentences: Итак, перед вами «Ханаанский бальзам» (его в просторечье называют «чернобуркой») – жидкость в самом деле черно-бурого цвета, с умеренной крепостью и стойким ароматом.
Это даже не аромат, а гимн.
Гимн демократической молодежи.
Именно так, потому что в выпившем этот коктейль вызревают вульгарность и темные силы.
Я сколько раз наблюдал!..
highlight.explain: The reason is given in the sentence about vulgarity and dark forces ripening in whoever drinks it.
